## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the existing issue. Describe the concrete before/after behavior.

## Ownership and scope

Agent/model, changed areas, dependencies and reviewer. New issues are created by Codex only unless the user explicitly authorizes another model.

## Verification

Exact commands, results, and required live/hardware checks. State any unverified acceptance criteria.

## Compatibility and deployment

Contract/client version support, per-type origins, existing-object migration, old-package authority, configuration changes and recovery requirements. Use "None" when not applicable.
